what: Inside a small circular window (radius 80px) at the center of a white curtain, a character peeks out from each corner in turn — at .4s the first enters from the top left in .4s cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1), stays .9s, and hides in .4s cubic-bezier(.4,0,1,1), then .1s later the second does the same from the bottom right at the same tempo. .2s after the last one hides, the circle spreads to the screen edges in 2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) to become the panel (fx:open fires .5s after that), and 1.3s after the spread starts the curtain lifts in .4s (fx:done). Scrolling is locked meanwhile

options.start: When the first character appears (s), default .4
options.gap: Gap between the previous character starting to hide and the next one appearing, default .1
options.grow-at: Time (seconds) when the circle starts to spread, default is .2s after the last character starts to hide (3.3 if there are two)
options.open-at: Time (s) to fire fx:open, default grow-at + .5 — the original plays the hero video at this point
options.fade-at: When the curtain starts to lift (seconds), default grow-at + 1.3 — scrolling unlocks then
options.once: If 1, once per tab (session) only — on return, fx:open and fx:done fire immediately with no curtain. Default 0 (always plays) — original 1
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: Spreading panel (surface covering the whole curtain, starts clipped to a circle) — window inside
options.[data-fx-part=window]: Round window in the center of the panel — crops the character
options.[data-fx-part=peek]: Characters in the window (several, appear in document order) — corner they appear from via data-key: tl (default)·tr·bl·br

note: Screens opened often, like an app, use shortened lengths (e.g. start: .1; stay: .3; grow: .8). Panel color is --kf-raised, curtain color is --kf-bg — for other colors, use the consumer’s css. The character art and its eye blink belong to the consumer

from.where: shared.js .h-loader (first page, first visit) — original loader module circleWrap (clip-path circle(80px) → circle(200%) 2s 3.3s)·char1/char2 peekUp·peekDown·loaderFade .4s 4.6s, the hero video plays via onNearlyComplete 500ms after circleExpand starts
